pages.text: Health 200, attack 20, knockback resistance 1.0, armor 5, movement speed 0.25.$(br)$(l)Slam$(): raises both arms and smashes down, dealing 12-31 damage within a 6-block radius.$(br)$(l)Snow Block Throw$(): its normal ranged attack; the block deals 16 direct damage and 8 splash damage, 18-block range.

$(l)Snowball Volley$(): used when many enemies are around; it spins and throws snowballs at up to 8 nearby units for 2 damage each. One extra volley can be dedicated to healing Mutant Snow Golems.$(br)Upgrades

$(l)Frost Breath Focus$(): unlocks Frost Breath, dealing 4 damage every 0.5s to units in a frontal cone while spitting 4 invulnerability-frame-ignoring snowballs for 2 damage each; 10-block reach.$(br)$(l)Chilling Focus$(): unlocks Chill Hide, granting itself 17.5s of Chill Hide IV and frost-type allies within 12 blocks Chill Hide I, 25s cooldown.
